title: C4OS Grill Question 017 - C4OS Plugin Manifest

questions.label: What should `agents/c4os.yaml` be responsible for in v1?
questions.help: Recommended: app-shell contribution metadata only. Keep Codex package metadata in `.codex-plugin/plugin.json`, and keep user config out of the plugin root.

questions.label: Which fields should `agents/c4os.yaml` include first?
questions.help: Recommended: id, display name, icon, default panel side, tool-view support, settings schema, dependencies, and menu contributions.
options: id, name, icon, panel, toolViews, settings, dependencies, menus
id, name, icon, panel, settings only
id, name, backend tools, permissions only
Use Codex plugin.json only; no c4os.yaml

questions.label: Notes or corrections
questions.help: Clarify whether backend activation, Tauri tool declarations, app menu items, and tool-view subscriptions belong here or elsewhere.
